Hi Dana and Sam,

Thanks for walking me through how Ridgeway runs dispatch on FlowOS across your three sites. It was clear that driver messaging is the gap, and Connect is built for exactly that.

To your questions: Connect is priced per site rather than per seat, so your cost would be based on your 3 sites. Sam, Connect uses the same single sign-on as FlowOS, so there should be little to set up on your side.

Sam, let's get the technical walkthrough on the calendar for the week of November 9. Dana, I know you need numbers before your November 15 budget meeting, so I'll make sure you have what you need.

Best,
[Your name]

length.reason: About right, though the opening paragraph tells Dana what she already knows.

person.reason: Warm and specific to Ridgeway, with one salesy line about Connect being built for exactly that.

Hi Jen,

Thank you so much for taking the time to meet with us today, and thanks to everyone who was able to join, including Raj from IT. It was really helpful to hear about how things work across your 9 branches today and your plans to possibly grow to 10 branches next year.

We heard a lot about the challenges your team faces with branch staffing, especially during the holiday rush when tellers call out sick and managers need to find coverage quickly. It's also good to know about the scheduling tool you tried in 2023 and how managers ended up going back to spreadsheets. That kind of history is really useful context for us.

I'm glad to hear you like FlowOS shift swapping. Many teams find that it makes a real difference during busy seasons like the holidays.

You asked about extending your trial since your board doesn't meet until January. FlowOS trials can be extended, and I'd be happy to look into that for you.

Please let me know if you have any other questions or if there is anything else I can do to help.

Best,
[Your name]

accurate.reason: The call details are right, but 'I'd be happy to look into that' makes the extension sound uncertain and never says it is one time, 14 days.

answers.reason: Touches the trial question without saying how long the extension is or whether it reaches January.

next_step.reason: Ends with 'let me know' and no owner or date, and Lisa Brandt is never mentioned.

length.reason: Nearly 190 words recapping the call back to Jen, the opposite of the short note she asked for.

person.reason: Polite but padded with stock phrases like 'really useful context for us'.
